# Typed SQL UDF cases from GoogleSQL's compliance/testdata/call_sql_udf.test.
# Each expected value is from that data, where the reference agrees with BigQuery.

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION Thousand() AS (1000);
SELECT Thousand() + Thousand()
=> "2000"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION Thousand() AS (1000);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION TimesThousand(value INT64) AS (value * Thousand());
SELECT TimesThousand(2)
=> "2000"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION StringIdentity(value STRING) AS (value);
SELECT StringIdentity('a')
=> "a"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION MyStringIsNull(value STRING) AS (value IS NULL);
SELECT MyStringIsNull(NULL)
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION MyStringIsNull(value STRING) AS (value IS NULL);
SELECT MyStringIsNull('a')
=> "false"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IntegerToDouble(value INT64) RETURNS FLOAT64 AS (value);
SELECT TYPEOF(IntegerToDouble(1))
=> "FLOAT64"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IntegerEquals(a INT64, b INT64) AS (a = b);
SELECT IntegerEquals(1, 2)
=> "false"

# Volatile arguments evaluate once even when the body references them twice.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION FloatReflexiveEquals(a FLOAT64) AS (a = a);
SELECT FloatReflexiveEquals(RAND())
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION StringIdentityCorrelated(value STRING) AS ((SELECT value));
SELECT StringIdentityCorrelated('a')
=> "a"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION AggregateArray(value ARRAY<INT64>) AS
  (ARRAY(SELECT elem + 1 FROM UNNEST(value) elem WITH OFFSET ORDER BY OFFSET));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(AggregateArray([1, 2, 3]))
=> "[2,3,4]"

# BigQuery's SQL UDF documentation:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions#sql_udfs
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION AddFourAndDivide(x INT64, y INT64) RETURNS FLOAT64 AS ((x + 4) / y);
SELECT AddFourAndDivide(3, 2)
=> "3.5"

# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions#scalar_subqueries
CREATE TEMP TABLE users AS
  (SELECT 1 AS id, 10 AS age UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 30 AS age UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS id, 10 AS age);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION countUserByAge(userAge INT64) AS
  ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users WHERE age = userAge));
SELECT countUserByAge(10)
=> "2"

# The same documented scalar subquery with a column passed as its argument.
CREATE TEMP TABLE users AS
  (SELECT 1 AS id, 10 AS age UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 30 AS age UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS id, 10 AS age);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION countUserByAge(userAge INT64) AS
  ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users WHERE age = userAge));
SELECT countUserByAge(age) FROM UNNEST([10]) AS age
=> "2"

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers.
# TEMP UDF boundaries checked against BigQuery.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) AS (x);
SELECT f(NULL)
=> null

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) AS (x);
SELECT f('')
=> ""

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x BYTES) AS (x);
SELECT TO_HEX(f(b'abc'))
=> "616263"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRUCT<a INT64>) AS (x);
SELECT f(STRUCT(1 AS a)).a
=> "1"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (IF(x = 0, 0, DIV(1, x)));
SELECT f(0)
=> "0"

DECLARE result FLOAT64;
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION AddFourAndDivide(x INT64, y INT64) RETURNS FLOAT64 AS ((x + 4) / y);
SET result = AddFourAndDivide(3, 2);
SELECT result
=> "3.5"

# Per-row volatile arguments must not become a shared uncorrelated scalar subquery.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x FLOAT64) AS (x);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f(RAND())) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100))
=> "100"
